answer: Clone ledgers cannot staff a color desk. An agent posts 36.4 POA and occupies one mixing slab in the potting garden for a full shift. A warden who arrives without notice drags a numbered velvet pad through a wet umber wash, presses it to a numbered glass plate, and requires a signature of the smear-hash within 26 seconds while the pad is still tacky. A room of remote copies cannot feel the smear or stand at that slab. A dry pad or a late signature slashes 7.2 POA and hands the desk to the next bonded mixer.
